/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('src/data/lyrics/bolo-ahl-aza-fatima-fatima.md')
original = path.read_bytes()
start = original.index(b'romanLyrics: |-\\n') + len(b'romanLyrics: |-\\n')
end = original.index(b'---\\n', start)
roman = \"\"\"  Bolo ahl-e-azaa Fatima Fatima

  1
  Mar gayi Sayyeda Fatima Fatima
  Shor girya hai aaj, aal-e-athaar meiṅ
  Haaye kya ho gaya Fatima Fatima

  2
  Hai sirhaane Ali, painti betiyaaṅ
  Hai Nabi ki sada Fatima Fatima

  3
  Maaṅ ke laashe se haiṅ, bete lipte hue
  Hai qayaamat bapa Fatima Fatima

  4
  Haaye baad-e-Nabi, zulm kya kya hue
  Aag aur ghar tera Fatima Fatima

  5
  Dar giraaya gaya, pahlu-e-paak par
  Tujh pe aur ye jafa Fatima Fatima

  6
  Qatl Mohsin hua, badan-e-athaar meiṅ
  Zulm kaisa hua Fatima Fatima

  7
  Haaye kya kya sitam, besabab sah gayi
  Ae Khuda ae Khuda Fatima Fatima

  8
  Muztarib hai Nagin, waqt-e-imdaad hai
  Hai tera aasra Fatima Fatima
\"\"\"
updated = original[:start] + roman.encode() + original[end:]
path.write_bytes(updated)
saved = path.read_bytes()
assert saved == updated
assert saved.split(b'---\\n', 2)[2] == original.split(b'---\\n', 2)[2]
source = original[end + 4:].decode().strip()
roman_blocks = roman.strip().split('\\n\\n')
source_blocks = source.split('\\n\\n')
assert len(roman_blocks) == len(source_blocks) == 9
assert [len(block.splitlines()) for block in roman_blocks] == [len(block.splitlines()) for block in source_blocks]
assert sum(len(block.splitlines()) for block in roman_blocks) - 8 == 18
print('Verified 18 verses across the opening and eight numbered stanzas. Urdu body unchanged byte-for-byte.')
PY"
